source_policy: Only encode rules supported by linked Microsoft Minecraft Creator documentation. A missing mapping means unknown, not unsupported.

notes: Preview feature; verify target game support.
Microsoft documentation notes metadata.author(s) is currently required by V3 processing.

memory_tier.notes: Each tier represents 250 MB; documentation says this is planned to be replaced by memory_performance_tier.

notes: Settings support is documented as experimental for behavior packs.
Resource-pack settings can be accessed through documented Molang queries.

script_api.policy: Historical exact mappings are provided only where Microsoft Learn explicitly lists them. Latest documented module versions are shown separately and must not be treated as exact game-version mappings.
notes: Beta API versions do not guarantee backward compatibility and may require the Beta APIs experiment.
Internal APIs are not supported for custom behavior packs.
Do not infer an API version for a Minecraft release missing from the mapping.

latest_documented_stable.evidence: Microsoft Learn lists 2.10.0 as latest stable module and lists 2.12.0-beta for preview 1.26.60; this is not a guarantee that every target game build supports it.

file_formats.rule: A JSON file's format_version describes that file type's data contract; it is not generally the same as the installed Minecraft version.
file_formats.note: Template defaults are starter examples only, not a guarantee of latest schema or compatibility with every component.

online_update.cache_policy: Use bundled data when available; retain last valid cached data when offline. Never execute downloaded code.

changes: Stricter entity JSON validation: invalid data in affected components and AI goals can prevent loading when entity format_version is 1.26.40 or later.
minecraft:multi_block trait and minecraft:instrument_sound block component moved out of experimental.
Ships @minecraft/server 2.9.0; @minecraft/server 2.10.0 and @minecraft/server-ui 2.2.0 are beta in these notes.
Duplicate feature identifiers in one behavior pack now produce a content-log error.
Pack files are compressed in archives and duplicate raw files in behavior/resource pack folders were removed.
Minecraft adopted year-based version numbering in 2026; API and file schema version numbers remain separate systems.
Released @minecraft/server v2.5.0, including additional stable block component types and player swing events.
EntityHurtAfterEvent now fires when damage amount is zero; fixes were made to ItemStack and Entity getComponents behavior in older script versions.
